item.title: BF Processes
item.description: BF Process Irena Bojanova, Inventor/Creator, PI & Lead, NIST Bugs Framework (BF), 2014 – ~~~ # The BF Processes are presented on Figure 1. Figure 1. Bugs Framework (BF) Processes for the BF Taxonomy Creation and BF Vulnerability Specifications Creation. The BF processes are the BF Taxonomy Creation (see the branch that starts with the Define/Refine BF Taxonomy Structure block on Figure 1) and the BF Vulnerability Specifications Creation (see the branch that starts with the Define/Refine BF Specification Structures block on Figure 1).
